Refugee Sponsorship

Helping families pursue safety, stability, and belonging.

Kingdom Path Society provides generic sponsorship guidance, preparation support, and compassionate community care for refugees and displaced families.

Sponsorship Support

Practical help for a complex journey.

Sponsorship can involve documents, coordination, settlement planning, and community support. Our role is to help families understand next steps and connect with care.

Initial Guidance

General information about sponsorship pathways and preparation.

Document Readiness

Support with organizing records, forms, and required materials.

Community Care

Volunteer teams and partners helping families feel welcomed.

Settlement Planning

Planning for practical needs before and after arrival.
